CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rakeezx.n73_build_distribution(p_source text, p_targets text[], p_remove text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT rakeezx.n73_build_distribution(p_source,p_targets,p_remove,'definitions');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rakeezx.plan_score_distribution(p_plan_id text, p_source text, p_targets text[], p_remove text[] DEFAULT '{}'::text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT rakeezx.plan_score_distribution(p_plan_id,p_source,p_targets,p_remove,'definitions');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rakeezx.score_distribution_capability()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select '{"targetPreservationVersion":1,"distributionApplyVersion":2,"protocol":"N73_D119_V2"}'::jsonb;
$function$
